project.name: TMCP packet runtime
project.identity: The TMCP runtime that turns a task identity and selected inputs into a compiled packet.
project.audience: Agent workflows and operators that need relevant context with source and selection reasons visible.
project.core_loop: Accept task identity, select governed inputs, compile the packet, and emit receipts or protocol results.
project.north_star: Every compiled packet is relevant enough for the task and reproducible from explicit inputs.
not_this: Hiding provider-specific behavior in the shared runtime

scope.purpose: Compile and recompile bounded advisory task packets with explicit source selection and safe optional persistence.
scope.boundary: Owns the launcher, runtime, MCP framing/server, packet composition, and runtime protocol under scripts; skill catalog policy and release packaging remain outside this child.
non_goals: Hiding provider-specific behavior in the shared runtime
